def axis(k, v, h, avg, adv, wall, sign):
    from scipy.sparse import csc_matrix
    n = len(k)
    kf = (k[:-1] + k[1:]) / 2 if avg == 'arith' else 2 * k[:-1] * k[1:] / (k[:-1] + k[1:])
    kf /= h * h
    m = np.zeros((n, n))
    j = np.arange(n - 1)
    m[j, j] += kf
    m[j + 1, j + 1] += kf
    m[j, j + 1] -= kf
    m[j + 1, j] -= kf
    v = sign * v / h
    vf = (v[:-1] + v[1:]) / 2
    if adv in ('flux', 'flux_edge', 'flux_left', 'flux_right'):
        if adv == 'flux_left':
            vf = v[:-1]
        if adv == 'flux_right':
            vf = v[1:]
        vp = np.maximum(vf, 0)
        vn = np.minimum(vf, 0)
        m[j, j] += vp
        m[j + 1, j] -= vp
        m[j, j + 1] += vn
        m[j + 1, j + 1] -= vn
        if adv == 'flux_edge':
            m[0, 0] += max(-v[0], 0)
            m[-1, -1] += max(v[-1], 0)
    elif adv in ('row', 'row_edge'):
        m[j + 1, j] -= np.maximum(v[1:], 0)
        m[j + 1, j + 1] += np.maximum(v[1:], 0)
        m[j, j + 1] += np.minimum(v[:-1], 0)
        m[j, j] -= np.minimum(v[:-1], 0)
        if adv == 'row_edge':
            m[0, 0] += max(v[0], 0)
            m[-1, -1] += max(-v[-1], 0)
    elif adv == 'row_face':
        m[j + 1, j] -= np.maximum(vf, 0)
        m[j + 1, j + 1] += np.maximum(vf, 0)
        m[j, j + 1] += np.minimum(vf, 0)
        m[j, j] -= np.minimum(vf, 0)
    return csc_matrix(m)
